title: perfcheck ids against the committed baseline exits 1 on main: the ten ids the sprint dropped on purpose are still in it
goal: python3 _tools/perfcheck.py ids --against _tools/test_ids_baseline.txt exits 0 on main: the baseline no longer names the ids _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt lists (or the check names --allow-removed), so a check that runs it proves the suite lost no test. BG-k5dql2np, ST-ykvho3zp, ST-5q5b5qtz and ST-n3swrm57 were marked done with this check while it printed '10 missing'. Found by the SP-w3xmbdra review.
